Answer: A
Reason: The axial CT image (Figure 1c) demonstrates a well-defined pulmonary nodule measuring approximately 25 mm in the posterior aspect of the right lung, which corresponds to the upper (apical) segment of the right lower lobe. Well-circumscribed nodules are a characteristic radiographic finding in nodular pulmonary amyloidosis, distinguishing it from options suggesting malignancy or incorrect locations/sizes.
